title: A rally tops out, and the vote waits for the real flip
premise: At the top the plain SuperTrend flips down and back up while the vote stays under 90% and nothing prints. Then one flip is confirmed: SELLERS prints, the trend line starts, and the Spectrum brightens as the drop runs.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips down (line 26,545.65), where a plain SuperTrend would signal. 28% of the vote sits in a settled downtrend, under the 90% threshold, so no card prints. Flips 1 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips back up (line 26,501.23): a plain SuperTrend would have signalled down, then up again. The vote never confirmed the flip down, so no card and no trend line were drawn. Flips 2 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: UNCONFIRMED
chapters.text: The SuperTrend flips down (line 26,548.17), where a plain SuperTrend would signal. 81% of the vote sits in a settled downtrend, under the 90% threshold, so no card prints. Flips 5 · confirmed 0.

chapters.title: SELLERS
chapters.text: The SuperTrend, down since 12:38, now has 92% of the vote among the 10 most similar past states in a settled downtrend — over the 90% threshold. The Neural Line agrees, so SELLERS prints: flip 5, the first confirmed.

chapters.title: STRONG DOWN
chapters.text: All four Spectrum SuperTrends point down and the bar ignites, so the candle brightens to strong down (magenta). The trend line and the Neural Line hold the short side.
